title.ja: 図1-1 矢倉囲い
title.en: Figure 1-1: Yagura castle

explain.ja: 矢倉囲いは図1-1のような形で、金銀3枚で玉を囲うのがポイントです。この金銀の形をよく覚えましょう。この矢倉囲いで戦う戦法を矢倉戦法といいます。
explain.en: The Yagura castle has the shape in Diagram 1-1, with the king surrounded by three golds and silvers. Learn this arrangement well. The strategy fought with the Yagura castle is called Yagura.

section.ja: 矢倉囲いって?縦の攻めに強く、横の攻めが弱点!
section.en: Yagura castle: strong against vertical attacks, weak to side attacks

title.ja: 図1-2 矢倉は縦の攻めに強い
title.en: Figure 1-2: Yagura is strong against attacks along the file

explain.ja: 矢倉囲いは縦からの攻めに強く、横からの攻めに弱いのが特徴です。そのため相手が上から攻めてくるときによく使われ、相手が居飛車のときに使う囲いです。相手が四間飛車のような振り飛車なら、上からの攻めを守っても仕方がありません。ここからは矢倉囲いの組み方を順に解説しますが、手順は絶対ではなく、相手の出方を見て柔軟に変える必要があります。
explain.en: The Yagura castle is strong against attacks from the front and weak against attacks from the side. So it is often used when the opponent attacks from above, namely against Static Rook. Against a Ranging Rook like Fourth File Rook, defending against attacks from above is pointless. Next we explain how to build the Yagura step by step, but this order is not absolute and must be adapted flexibly to the opponent's play.

section.ja: 矢倉囲いって?縦の攻めに強く、横の攻めが弱点!
section.en: Yagura castle: strong against vertical attacks, weak to side attacks

title.ja: 図2-1 まずは角道を開ける
title.en: Figure 2-1: First, open the bishop diagonal

explain.ja: まず角道を開けるのが基本です。この手は矢倉戦法以外の戦法にも変化しやすいので、最初は相手の出方を見るためにも、矢倉の形に決めすぎないのが良いでしょう。
explain.en: First, opening the bishop diagonal is basic. This move can transpose to strategies other than Yagura, so at first avoid committing to Yagura too early and watch the opponent's play.

section.ja: まず角道を開ける
section.en: First, open the bishop diagonal

title.ja: 図2-2 カニ囲い
title.en: Figure 2-2: Crab castle

explain.ja: 図2-1から金銀を2段目に上げます。図2-2の形は「カニ囲い」と呼ばれ、通常の矢倉はこのカニ囲いを経由して組みます。場合によってはカニ囲いのまま攻めを始めることもあり、これを「急戦矢倉」と呼びます。玉の斜め上の2枚の金がカニのハサミに似ているのでこの名があります。
explain.en: From Diagram 2-1, raise the golds and silvers to the second rank. The shape in Diagram 2-2 is called the Crab castle, and a normal Yagura is built via the Crab castle. Sometimes the attack starts from the Crab castle itself, which is called Rapid Attack Yagura. It is named for the two golds diagonally above the king resembling crab claws.

section.ja: カニ囲いを組もう!
section.en: Let's build the Crab castle!

title.ja: 図2-3 金銀を矢倉の形に
title.en: Figure 2-3: Gold and silver into Yagura shape

explain.ja: 金銀を上げて矢倉の外枠を作ります。あとは玉を矢倉の中に入れれば完成です。
explain.en: Raise the golds and silvers to make the outer frame of the Yagura. Then move the king inside to finish.

section.ja: 金銀を矢倉の形に
section.en: Form golds and silvers into a Yagura shape

title.ja: 図2-4 角を退かす
title.en: Figure 2-4: Move the bishop away

explain.ja: 玉を8八に移動させるため、まず角を退けてスペースを作ります。
explain.en: To move the king to 8八, first move the bishop away to make space.

section.ja: 玉を入城させて完成!
section.en: Bring the king in to complete the castle

title.ja: 図2-8 矢倉囲いの完成！
title.en: Figure 2-8: Yagura castle complete!

explain.ja: 玉を囲いの中に入れて矢倉囲いの完成です。細かい手順を覚える必要はなく、矢倉囲いの完成形を覚えておけば、実戦では好きな手順で組んで構いません。実戦では相手の出方を見て手順を変える必要があります。
explain.en: Moving the king into the castle completes the Yagura. You don't need to memorize the exact move order; if you remember the finished shape, you can build it in any order you like in real games. In real games you must change the order according to the opponent's play.

section.ja: 玉を入城させて完成!
section.en: Bring the king in to complete the castle

title.ja: 図3-1 まずは角道を開ける
title.en: Figure 3-1: First, open the bishop diagonal

explain.ja: まず先手で矢倉囲いを組む手順を見ます。こちらが角道を開けたところで、相手は飛車先を突いてきました。
explain.en: First, see how to build a Yagura as Black. After you open the bishop diagonal, the opponent pushes the rook pawn.

section.ja: 飛車先を伸ばされたら▲7七銀としよう!
section.en: If the rook pawn is pushed, play ▲7七銀!

title.ja: 図3-2 相手が飛車先を突いたら銀を上がる
title.en: Figure 3-2: When the opponent pushes the rook-file pawn, advance the silver

explain.ja: 相手が飛車先の歩を突いたら、▲6八銀としておきます。
explain.en: When the opponent pushes the rook pawn, play ▲6八銀.

section.ja: 飛車先を伸ばされたら▲7七銀としよう!
section.en: If the rook pawn is pushed, play ▲7七銀!

title.ja: 図3-3 銀で飛車先を受ける
title.en: Figure 3-3: Receive the rook-file pawn with the silver

explain.ja: 銀を上げて飛車先を受けておきます。これで△8六歩、▲同歩、△同飛と飛車先の歩の交換を狙われても受けられます。この後はじっくり矢倉囲いを目指して駒組みします。銀を上げるのがあと一手遅れていたら、飛車先を受けられませんでした。
explain.en: Raise the silver to guard against the rook pawn. Now even if the opponent aims at a rook-pawn exchange with △8六歩 ▲同歩 △同飛, you can handle it. After that, patiently build toward the Yagura. If the silver had been one move later, the rook pawn could not have been guarded.

section.ja: 飛車先を伸ばされたら▲7七銀としよう!
section.en: If the rook pawn is pushed, play ▲7七銀!

title.ja: 図a-1 ▲同銀で飛車が取れる
title.en: Figure a-1: ▲同銀 wins the rook

explain.ja: 図3-3から相手が△8六歩、▲同歩、△同飛と指してきたら、最後に▲同銀として飛車を取れます。このように8六に銀などの利きを足しておけば、相手は飛車先の歩を交換できなくなります。
explain.en: From Diagram 3-3, if the opponent plays △8六歩 ▲同歩 △同飛, you can capture the rook with ▲同銀. By adding a silver's control to 8六 like this, the opponent cannot exchange the rook pawn.

section.ja: 飛車先を伸ばされたら▲7七銀としよう!
section.en: If the rook pawn is pushed, play ▲7七銀!

title.ja: 図3-4 今度は相手が角道を開けてきた
title.en: Figure 3-4: This time the opponent opened the bishop diagonal

explain.ja: 今度は相手が初手から別の手を指した場合です。後手が角道を開けてきたときは、どう指すのが良いでしょうか。
explain.en: Now the case where the opponent plays differently from the start. How should you play when White opens the bishop diagonal?

section.ja: 角道を開けられたら、▲6六歩として角交換拒否
section.en: If the bishop diagonal is opened, play ▲6六歩 and refuse the bishop exchange

title.ja: 図3-5 角交換されるのを防ぐ
title.en: Figure 3-5: Prevent the bishop exchange

explain.ja: ▲6六歩と角道を閉じて、角交換を拒否するのが無難な駒組みです。角交換を避けて矢倉に組めます。
explain.en: Closing the bishop diagonal with ▲6六歩 and refusing a bishop exchange is the safe way to develop. You can avoid the bishop exchange and still build a Yagura.

section.ja: 角道を開けられたら、▲6六歩として角交換拒否
section.en: If the bishop diagonal is opened, play ▲6六歩 and refuse the bishop exchange

title.ja: 図3-6 やはり▲6八銀～▲7七銀
title.en: Figure 3-6: Still ▲6八銀 to ▲7七銀

explain.ja: ここから相手が飛車先を伸ばしてきたら、やはり▲6八銀から▲7七銀として、相手の飛車先の交換を受けておきます。これでじっくり矢倉囲いに組めます。
explain.en: If the opponent then pushes the rook pawn, again guard against the rook-pawn exchange with ▲6八銀 and ▲7七銀. This lets you build the Yagura patiently.

section.ja: 角道を開けられたら、▲6六歩として角交換拒否
section.en: If the bishop diagonal is opened, play ▲6六歩 and refuse the bishop exchange

title.ja: 図b-1 △3四歩に▲6八銀とすると…
title.en: Figure b-1: If ▲6八銀 after △3四歩...

explain.ja: 相手が角道を開けてきたのに、うっかり▲6八銀とすると、△8八角成で角を取られます。矢倉を組むときは、いつも同じ手を指すのではなく、相手の指し手を見て隙を見せないように駒組みしましょう。
explain.en: If the opponent has opened the bishop diagonal and you carelessly play ▲6八銀, △8八角成 captures your bishop. When building a Yagura, don't always play the same moves; watch the opponent's moves and develop without leaving a weakness.

section.ja: 角道を開けられたら、▲6六歩として角交換拒否
section.en: If the bishop diagonal is opened, play ▲6六歩 and refuse the bishop exchange

title.ja: 図3-7 後手番に矢倉に組む！
title.en: Figure 3-7: Build Yagura as White!

explain.ja: 今度は後手番で矢倉囲いに組む手順を見ます。相手がいきなり飛車先を突いてきましたが、どう受ければよいでしょうか。先ほどのように△3三銀と銀で受けたくても、手が間に合いません。
explain.en: Now see how to build a Yagura as White. The opponent pushes the rook pawn immediately; how should you defend? You would like to defend with the silver by △3三銀 as before, but there is no time.

section.ja: 後手番で矢倉囲いを組む、ウソ矢倉(無理やり矢倉)の駒組み
section.en: Building Yagura as White: the fake Yagura (forced Yagura) piece setup

title.ja: 図3-8 角で飛車先を受ける
title.en: Figure 3-8: Receive the rook-file pawn with the bishop

explain.ja: この場合は△3三角と角で飛車先を受けます。矢倉囲いの形からは遠ざかりますが、序盤からいきなり飛車先を交換させるわけにはいきません。この形からは、矢倉でなく雁木囲いに組むのもおすすめです。
explain.en: In this case defend the rook pawn with the bishop by △3三角. It moves away from the Yagura shape, but you cannot let the opponent exchange the rook pawn right from the opening. From this shape, building a Gangi castle instead of a Yagura is also recommended.

section.ja: 後手番で矢倉囲いを組む、ウソ矢倉(無理やり矢倉)の駒組み
section.en: Building Yagura as White: the fake Yagura (forced Yagura) piece setup

title.ja: 図3-9 角交換を防ぐ
title.en: Figure 3-9: Prevent the bishop exchange

explain.ja: 相手が角道を開けてきたら、やはり角道を閉じるのが矢倉の基本です。この駒組みは「ウソ矢倉」または「無理やり矢倉」と呼ばれます。四間飛車などの振り飛車と同じ出だしですが、ここから振り飛車ではなく矢倉に組むので、この名があります。
explain.en: If the opponent opens the bishop diagonal, closing yours is again the basis of Yagura. This development is called Fake Yagura (usō yagura) or Forced Yagura. It starts the same as Ranging Rook such as Fourth File Rook, but builds a Yagura instead, hence the name.

section.ja: 後手番で矢倉囲いを組む、ウソ矢倉(無理やり矢倉)の駒組み
section.en: Building Yagura as White: the fake Yagura (forced Yagura) piece setup

title.ja: 図3-10 △2二銀と上がるのがポイント
title.en: Figure 3-10: The key is advancing △2二銀

explain.ja: ウソ矢倉の駒組みでは、銀を△4二銀ではなく△2二銀と左側に上げるのがポイントです。将来的に△4二角と引けるようにするためです。
explain.en: In Fake Yagura development, the key is to raise the silver to the left with △2二銀 instead of △4二銀. This is so the bishop can later retreat to 4二.

section.ja: 後手番で矢倉囲いを組む、ウソ矢倉(無理やり矢倉)の駒組み
section.en: Building Yagura as White: the fake Yagura (forced Yagura) piece setup

title.ja: 図3-11 金も上がっておく
title.en: Figure 3-11: Advance the gold too

explain.ja: この後は金も上げて、矢倉囲いの形を目指します。
explain.en: After this, raise the golds as well and aim for the Yagura shape.

section.ja: 後手番で矢倉囲いを組む、ウソ矢倉(無理やり矢倉)の駒組み
section.en: Building Yagura as White: the fake Yagura (forced Yagura) piece setup

line.text: ▲7八金、△3二金、▲6八銀、△5二金、▲5八金、△4三金

title.ja: 図3-12 角を引いておく
title.en: Figure 3-12: Retreat the bishop

explain.ja: 金を上げた後は、△4二角と角を引きます。あらかじめ金を上げておいたおかげで、▲4四角と角が出てくる手を防げます。また▲2四歩と飛車先を突かれても、角が2四に利いているので問題ありません。
explain.en: After raising the gold, retreat the bishop with △4二角. Raising the gold beforehand prevents the bishop from coming out with ▲4四角. Also, even if the rook pawn is pushed with ▲2四歩, the bishop covers 2四, so it is fine.

section.ja: 後手番で矢倉囲いを組む、ウソ矢倉(無理やり矢倉)の駒組み
section.en: Building Yagura as White: the fake Yagura (forced Yagura) piece setup

title.ja: 図3-13 矢倉囲いの形が完成
title.en: Figure 3-13: Yagura castle shape complete

explain.ja: 最後に銀を上げれば矢倉囲いの形が完成します。ここから玉を2二まで移動すれば矢倉囲いが組めます。1手ごとの意味を理解して覚えましょう。
explain.en: Finally, raising the silver completes the Yagura shape. Moving the king to 2二 from here completes the Yagura. Learn it by understanding the meaning of each move.

section.ja: 後手番で矢倉囲いを組む、ウソ矢倉(無理やり矢倉)の駒組み
section.en: Building Yagura as White: the fake Yagura (forced Yagura) piece setup

title.ja: 図c-1 後手番なら角交換は避けられない
title.en: Figure c-1: As White, a bishop exchange is unavoidable

explain.ja: 後手番で矢倉囲いを目指すときは注意が必要です。初手から▲7六歩、△3四歩と進んだところでいきなり▲2二角成と角交換される手があり、角交換を避けられません。角交換されると矢倉戦法にならず角換わりになるので、居飛車党は矢倉戦法とあわせて角換わりも覚えておくと良いでしょう。
explain.en: Take care when aiming for a Yagura as White. After ▲7六歩 △3四歩, Black can suddenly exchange bishops with ▲2二角成, and you cannot avoid the exchange. After the exchange it becomes Bishop Exchange instead of Yagura, so Static Rook players should learn Bishop Exchange along with Yagura.

section.ja: 後手番で矢倉囲いを組む、ウソ矢倉(無理やり矢倉)の駒組み
section.en: Building Yagura as White: the fake Yagura (forced Yagura) piece setup
